scope: Selected decision reconsiderations for filter parameter cells; not a general review of every filter ADR.

decisions.decision_review: Retain their filter pipeline/stage association and LZW width-transition decisions. Current direct-parameter tests provide independent decoded-byte expectations. These decisions do not answer indirect numeric DecodeParms resolution; that separate issue is already recorded as B54.
decisions.status: retained; no new draft duplicates these decisions

decisions.decision_review: Retain the Table 11 distinction between Rows and EndOfBlock. A valid delimiter must be present to use the clause's EOB rule as a positive control. The existing Rows-shorter test lacks RTC and does not settle the valid-stream case; the new draft adds the valid Group 4 EOFB path.
decisions.status: source/assertion gap drafted; pending parent execution

decisions.decision_review: The custom CCITT decoder remains a justified consumer of DamagedRowsBeforeError because it exposes line damage and recovery detail; the Table 11 applicable-condition controls are meaningful. This audit does not independently certify all T.4/T.6 codewords.

The project choice to draw rows delivered before a decode shortfall and report omitted rows is distinct from the specification's Table 11 decoding controls. Tests of the blank remainder establish the project policy; they are not cited as a required normative fill color.
decisions.status: retained as product/error-report policy; no normative defect claimed

decisions.decision_review: Do not treat bounded resource/geometry policy or padding compatibility checks as additional Table 11 requirements. Width mismatch beyond the permitted byte padding is a cross-clause consistency/policy boundary, not a standalone refusal rule in Table 11.
decisions.status: scope qualified; no ADR change proposed

decisions.decision_review: Pinned JBIG2 decoder provenance and worker confinement are relevant implementation controls, but Annex/T.88 examples and family-equality tests are not a normative expected-bitmap oracle. The reviewed PDF integration covers the standard example route; no unsupported decoder behavior is inferred.
